body.text:
Bloating after every meal is so common that most women assume it is just how their body works.

It isn't. It's a signal.

When a client tells us she is bloated all the time we want to know why:
→ enough stomach acid and enzymes to break food down?
→ an overgrowth or imbalance in the gut?
→ foods that trigger it?
→ constipation or slow motility?
→ eating on the go, stressed, in a rush?

Common doesn't mean normal.

We can help. Book a complimentary consultation.
